perks: Make it yours. Choose your Card background, favourite Rewind Era film and TV show, soundtrack, Patron Saint and what you’re carrying. Change them whenever you fancy a MAiKEOVER.
Save your spot in the LIBRAiRY. Your Card unlocks a pouch of ten Puffy Stickers. Use them to bookmark a book, chapter or exact section, then reopen it from your Closet on this device.
Give your collections a home. Keep your hidden charms, trading cards, quiz stickers and KSVL sticker picks together in your Closet.
See how far you’ve come. Return to your episode, check your Pop Quiz scores and see which stops you’ve completed on the weekly tour.
access:
Just visiting
Read the episodes, browse books and news, listen to KSVL and try the games. Search LAiDIES with Miss Jeeves as often as you like. FAiRY’s current beta gives guests up to one case a day, with up to three follow-up fittings per completed case.

Make a Resident Card
Create your town ID at MAiKEOVER on MAiN, open your Closet and start using your Puffy bookmarks. You can do this before signing in. Your Card and activity begin in this browser; Puffy bookmarks stay on this device.

Connect your private account
Sign in to keep your Card, episode position, completed tours, charms and trading cards available across devices. You also get more time with FAiRY: up to three cases a day in the current beta. Each completed case includes up to three follow-up fittings to work through her advice.
